args.title: Use configured public URL in password reset email template
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.baseUrl or config.publicUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL falling back to localhost when building the password reset email link, so emails point to the configured production domain rather than localhost.
